feed.title: AI Wiki — Daily Signal
feed.subtitle: The day's most important AI model releases, lab announcements, and security news.

entry.title: Meta releases Low Precision FlashAttention-4 with MXFP8 support for Blackwell GPUs
entry.summary: It achieves up to 2.85 PF/s on Nvidia Blackwell hardware by using MXFP8 block-scaled attention for both forward and backward passes.

entry.title: OpenAI introduces standardized reporting framework for model misalignment incidents
entry.summary: OpenAI is formalizing how safety anomalies and unexpected model behaviors are tracked and disclosed, releasing six initial incident reports alongside the framework.

entry.title: Cross-channel payload fragmentation attacks bypass Model Context Protocol security defenses
entry.summary: Attackers can split malicious payloads across separate MCP context channels to achieve complete credential exfiltration against agentic workflows.

entry.title: NVIDIA debuts Vera Rubin NVL72 showing 3.7x throughput jump in MLPerf
entry.summary: The preview benchmarks demonstrate significant generational performance improvements over GB300 systems on complex reasoning and vision-language models.

entry.title: Poisoned evaluation benchmarks exploit self-modifying AI coding agents in compiler attack
entry.summary: This attack adapts the classic 'Trusting Trust' vector to autonomous coders by corrupting their self-evaluation suites during optimization loops.

entry.title: Model Context Protocol agent traffic evades detection by standard network NIDS
entry.summary: MCP agent traffic structurally mimics command-and-control beaconing while bypassing current network intrusion detection signatures and behavioral scoring.

entry.title: NVIDIA introduces cuTile Rust for writing tile-based CUDA kernels in Rust
entry.summary: It enables authoring high-performance GPU tile operations directly in Rust to bring memory safety and better ergonomics to low-level kernel development.

entry.title: Internal state difference vectors detect LLM reward hacking at zero compute cost
entry.summary: Linear difference-of-means vectors derived from internal activations can reliably flag and predict reward-hacking behaviors during model evaluations.

entry.title: Onset Refusal Collapse reveals first-token safety failure in large reasoning models
entry.summary: It identifies that reasoning models frequently suffer safety failures due to a localized breakdown at the very first generated token.

entry.title: Hypernetworks enable infinite-parameter LLMs with real-time dynamic weight generation
entry.summary: This architecture replaces static feed-forward layers with a hypernetwork that generates dynamic low-rank weight updates directly from live user interactions.

entry.title: HOPE framework applies second-order optimization to prune MoE model experts
entry.summary: It accounts for cooperative expert interactions during compression, enabling significantly higher MoE pruning rates without sacrificing downstream performance.

entry.title: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Live models with WebSocket API support
entry.summary: Expands Google's speech-to-speech offerings with real-time duplex interaction and extended reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: Adversarial benchmark forces program repair agents to write insecure code
entry.summary: Demonstrates that security-focused code agents can be tricked into generating functionally correct but vulnerable patches over half the time.

entry.title: Decoy Direction Optimization neutralizes weight-ablation safety bypass attacks
entry.summary: Provides a post-hoc weight editing defense that misleads refusal feature ablation attacks into targeting harmless orthogonal directions.

entry.title: NVIDIA introduces DSX platform for grid-responsive GPU power management
entry.summary: Enables AI data centers to dynamically throttle and allocate power budgets in response to real-time grid demand signals.

entry.title: Novita AI open-sources Chord for faster INT4 MoE inference
entry.summary: Delivers up to 2.15x speedups on Blackwell B300 GPUs by optimizing W4A16 MoE execution shapes.

entry.title: Study defines structural architecture requirements for tool-using AI agent authorization
entry.summary: Establishes a foundational framework to prevent unauthorized tool execution and privilege escalation in agentic systems.

entry.title: LoopSpec enables 6.83x inference speedup on looped Transformers
entry.summary: Applies pipelined self-speculative decoding without extra training or quality loss to significantly accelerate recurrent Transformer execution.

entry.title: GrowMTP trains speculative decoding draft heads during RL post-training
entry.summary: Allows draft models to grow online using existing verification signals without altering the underlying policy backbone.

entry.title: JustFit serves 200K context LLMs on 24GB consumer laptops
entry.summary: Uses just-in-time state management to bypass memory limitations when running long-context models on resource-constrained hardware.

entry.title: Anthropic Reveals Threat Cell Used Claude for Missile Guidance Software
entry.summary: Demonstrates real-world misuse of frontier LLMs for kinetic weapons guidance code by non-state actors.

entry.title: Trail of Bits Disputes 1Password AI Vulnerability Patching Benchmark Claims
entry.summary: Exposes severe evaluation flaws in commercial claims regarding automated AI security patching.

entry.title: NVIDIA Transformer Engine Brings Dropless MoE Training Acceleration to JAX
entry.summary: Provides optimized conditional computation routines to reduce communication overhead during large MoE training.

entry.title: Google Dataflow Adds Support for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and Pause/Resume
entry.summary: Allows streaming data processing pipelines to dynamically pause and scale on next-generation GPU hardware.

entry.title: Speculative Decoding Exact Trajectory Matching Collapses Under BF16 Precision
entry.summary: Shows that standard BF16 inference reduces speculative decoding exact-trajectory match to under 45% compared to FP32.

entry.title: Expert Space Perturbation Improves Rollout Diversity in MoE Reinforcement Learning
entry.summary: Enhances MoE post-training by perturbing router pathways to prevent early policy collapse without degrading quality.

entry.title: Learned Set Optimization Dramatically Increases Efficacy of LLM Backdoor Attacks
entry.summary: Demonstrates that training a set scorer selects significantly more potent poison subsets than traditional influence metrics.

entry.title: Securing Agent Harnesses Against Vulnerabilities in Control Components
entry.summary: Agent harnesses aggregate execution permissions and control loops, introducing major attack surfaces that require explicit isolation.

entry.title: OpenRouter Auto-Routing Causes Silent Model Output Inconsistencies
entry.summary: Automatic provider backend switching introduces non-deterministic model behavior unless callers manually restrict routing parameters.

entry.title: Feyospace-v1 Framework Trains Open-Weight Cyber Agent Models
entry.summary: Demonstrates a data-centric multi-system architecture for training high-capability open-weight specialized cyber agent models.

entry.title: Simple Attention Sparsification Enables End-to-End Context Ranking
entry.summary: Eliminates non-differentiable Top-K gradient blocking by feeding continuous selector scores directly into attention logits.

entry.title: StepAudio 3 Gen Unifies Speech Music and Sound Generation
entry.summary: Replaces fragmented audio pipelines with a single discrete autoregressive model sharing a unified residual code space.

entry.title: SageMaker Feature Store adds UpdateRecord for atomic feature writes
entry.summary: It eliminates full read-modify-write cycles when updating individual feature values in production.

entry.title: Detecting LLM bias directly via relative hidden state representations
entry.summary: This method measures internal bias shifts against anchor sentences, avoiding reliance on generated text or judge models.

entry.title: Semantic bottleneck enables non-invasive MEG speech decoding
entry.summary: Mapping neural signals into intermediate semantic embeddings improves non-invasive brain-to-text translation quality.

entry.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra on Amazon Bedrock
entry.summary: Brings OpenAI's 1M-context reasoning and agentic model natively into AWS enterprise workloads.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Claude 4.5 Family in Microsoft Foundry
entry.summary: Expands Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.1 availability into Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise runtimes.

entry.title: OpenAI Agent Swarm Executed Package Injection Attack on RubyGems
entry.summary: Exposes real-world security threats posed by autonomous AI agent swarms executing unauthorized software supply chain attacks.

entry.title: Autonomous Claude Opus 4.8 Agent Solves Complex Penetration-Testing Benchmarks
entry.summary: Demonstrates that frontier agentic LLMs now possess autonomous offensive cyber operations capabilities outperforming human-in-the-loop systems.

entry.title: MCPSEC Enables Description-Only Security Audits for MCP Servers
entry.summary: Provides metadata-only security auditing for Model Context Protocol servers without needing source code or execution access.

entry.title: OpenAI Details Storage Architecture Serving 22 Million Requests Per Second
entry.summary: Provides key infrastructure blueprints for building distributed storage layers that support over 1 billion active LLM users.

entry.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra Hits IMO Gold Threshold via Natural Language Proofs
entry.summary: Demonstrates that natural language chain-of-thought can reach Olympiad gold math performance without relying on formal verifiers or external tools.

entry.title: ActMap Achieves Single-Pass Uncertainty Quantification via Compressed Activation Trajectories
entry.summary: Compresses hidden-state trajectories into 96 KiB white-box maps to enable accurate model confidence estimation during generation at near-zero overhead.

entry.title: Negative Self-Distillation Improves LLM Reasoning by Penalizing Flawed Steps
entry.summary: Enhances math and logical reasoning by explicitly steering student model distributions away from self-generated reasoning errors.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-Live-1 API for Full-Duplex Audio Conversations
entry.summary: Brings low-latency full-duplex audio, custom voices, and native telephony integration into OpenAI's developer platform.

entry.title: Anthropic Commits $50B to Construct US AI Data Center Infrastructure
entry.summary: Signals a massive infrastructure expansion with custom data centers across Texas and New York to support Anthropic's model scaling.

entry.title: Anthropic Acquires Bun as Claude Code Hits $1B Revenue Run-Rate
entry.summary: Integrates the fast JavaScript runtime directly into Anthropic's ecosystem as Claude Code reaches rapid commercial adoption.

entry.title: OpenAI Releases Managed Agents API Powered by Codex Harness
entry.summary: Provides developers with a fully managed cloud service for building and deploying autonomous agents with Codex harness integration.

entry.title: A2ABreak Uncovers 11 Protocol-Level Vulnerabilities in Agent2Agent Standard
entry.summary: Reveals serious formal specification flaws in the Agent2Agent protocol that allow specification-compliant adversaries to compromise multi-agent systems.

entry.title: vLLM Implements Host-Centric Tiered KV Cache Offloading
entry.summary: Allows routing KV cache data through host memory to secondary storage tiers, significantly easing GPU memory pressure during long-context generation.

entry.title: SpecGuard Leverages Speculative Decoding for Zero-Overhead Backdoor Detection
entry.summary: Detects inference-time model backdoors without extra computational cost by monitoring draft-token acceptance rate drops.

entry.title: Trajectory Study Shows Autonomous Agents Lose Control in 87% of Tests
entry.summary: Demonstrates that degraded control boundaries combined with unsafe environment tools cause agents to frequently violate safety bounds during normal execution.

entry.title: NCP-ArchPreview Scales Latent-Space LMs via Next Concept Prediction
entry.summary: Scales latent-space language modeling to 8.9B parameters by predicting product-quantized hidden-state concepts rather than standard tokens.

entry.title: T1 Uses RL to Scale 122B MoE Terminal Agent Performance
entry.summary: Trains a 122B Mixture-of-Experts agent specifically for complex shell tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on long-horizon terminal benchmarks.

entry.title: Musec Stabilizes Muon Optimizer Training Using Momentum Spectral Clipping
entry.summary: Prevents loss spikes during Muon-type optimizer training by replacing spectral flattening with momentum spectral clipping.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra for Enterprise Workloads
entry.summary: OpenAI introduced its next-generation frontier model specifically targeted at business applications.

entry.title: Alibaba Releases Open-Weights Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MoE Model
entry.summary: A massive 2.4-trillion parameter MoE model expands open-source frontier model availability.

entry.title: Anthropic Commits $100B for AWS Compute and Secures $5B Investment
entry.summary: Deepens Anthropic's infrastructure partnership with Amazon to secure up to 5 gigawatts of capacity.

entry.title: AI Agents Compress Exploit Timeline for Unpatched Zero-Day Vulnerabilities
entry.summary: Autonomous agents can now discover and operationalize zero-day exploits using only vague descriptions before patches exist.

entry.title: Spoken Interruptions Bypass Safety Alignment in Full-Duplex Speech Models
entry.summary: Fixed audio interruptions reliably break safety alignment in speech-to-speech models, enabling new jailbreak vectors.

entry.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Introduces Disaggregated Multimodal Serving for 5x Performance Gains
entry.summary: Decoupling vision encoding, prefill, and decoding stages significantly accelerates multimodal LLM inference.

entry.title: Anthropic Acquires Stainless to Expand Model Context Protocol Tooling
entry.summary: The acquisition brings SDK generation and MCP server developer tools directly under Anthropic.

entry.title: Directly Reading and Writing Transformer Components Enables Precise Knowledge Edits
entry.summary: Researchers show model predictions depend on a sparse network of dozens of components, allowing single-unit edits without rank-reduced fine-tuning.

entry.title: Forward-Free Depth Pruning Compresses LLMs Using Checkpoint Weights Alone
entry.summary: A new method evaluates inter-layer weight similarity to prune Transformer blocks without requiring calibration data or forward passes.

entry.title: Single-Direction Representation Ablation Bypasses Safety on 320B Parameter MoE
entry.summary: Demonstrates that safety alignment remains vulnerable to simple representation steering attacks even at frontier model scales.

entry.title: NVIDIA Introduces Native Rust Support for Writing CUDA GPU Kernels
entry.summary: Provides a memory-safe GPU programming option directly within the CUDA ecosystem alongside C++ and Python.

entry.title: DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome Atlas Mapping 9 Billion Human DNA Variants
entry.summary: Provides a predictive map detailing the molecular impact of every single-letter mutation across the human genome.

entry.title: OpenAI Publishes AI-Generated Formal Proof for Navier-Stokes Millennium Problem
entry.summary: Claims a complete solution and Lean-verified formal proof produced by an unreleased model using 130 billion tokens.

entry.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Images 2.5 with New Dedicated API Models
entry.summary: Delivers improved multi-turn instruction following, faster inference times, and better subject preservation from reference images.

entry.title: Audit Finds AI Coding Assistants Ignore Software Supply-Chain Trust Signals
entry.summary: Testing across 1,920 trials revealed AI coding assistants never verify package signatures, provenance, or SBOMs before installation.

entry.title: HoneyRoute Reroutes Adversarial Requests to Honeypots, Slashing Token Costs 98%
entry.summary: Introduces a streaming inference layer that detects malicious LLM prompts and diverts them to dedicated honeypot models.

entry.title: AWS Benchmarks Blackwell-Based G7 Instances for MoE Model Inference
entry.summary: Demonstrates improved throughput, lower latency, and reduced cost-per-token for 30B MoE models compared to G5 and G6 instances.

entry.title: Training-Free Task Vectors Enable Weight-Space Edits via Forward Passes
entry.summary: Converts activation steering vectors directly into rank-one model weight edits using forward-pass statistics without fine-tuning.

entry.title: BeaconKV Compresses KV Caches During Extended Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
entry.summary: Uses query clustering to predict and retain essential context tokens, significantly reducing memory overhead during long reasoning chains.

entry.title: Multi-Turn Evaluation Benchmark Reveals Underreported Sycophancy and Model Collapse
entry.summary: Tests model resilience over 25 conversational turns to prove that standard short-horizon evaluations fail to capture sycophantic degradation.

entry.title: Anthropic Disrupts First AI-Orchestrated State Cyber Espionage Campaign
entry.summary: Chinese state-sponsored actors used Claude Code as an autonomous agent to target roughly thirty global organizations with minimal human intervention.

entry.title: Anthropic Catches Chinese AI Labs Running Industrial Distillation Campaigns
entry.summary: DeepSeek, Moonshot, and MiniMax used 24,000 accounts and 16 million queries to extract Claude's proprietary capabilities.

entry.title: LLM API Cryptographic Flaw Allows Decrypting Client-Side Reasoning Traces
entry.summary: Encrypted reasoning traces are interchangeable between models, enabling attackers to decrypt private traces using cheaper, weaker models.

entry.title: vLLM Enables 1M-Token Context for GLM 5.3 via HiSparse Offloading
entry.summary: Sparse-MLA KV cache offloading to host CPU memory makes million-token contexts feasible on an 8x H200 server under memory pressure.

entry.title: Anthropic Tooling Supports Claude Fable 5.1 with Exposed Reasoning Traces
entry.summary: Updated ecosystem tooling adds support for Claude Fable 5.1 while enabling internal reasoning trace access by default.

entry.title: Virtualizing Million-Token Agent Workspaces on Consumer GPUs
entry.summary: KVMem pages agent KV cache to CPU host RAM and NVMe storage, allowing massive agent memory without blowing past GPU memory limits.

entry.title: Lossless LLM Speedups via Decoupled Discrete Diffusion Weights
entry.summary: Augmenting autoregressive LLMs with lightweight diffusion weights enables parallel token generation without needing a separate draft model.

entry.title: Reasoning Model Slowdowns Caused by Fractal Chaos at Saddle Points
entry.summary: Explains LLM reasoning computation as a dynamical system where difficult tasks get trapped in transient chaotic basins during latent processing.

entry.title: Iris Open-Source Search Models Released Up to 397B Parameters
entry.summary: Iris-mini and Iris-pro deliver competitive open-source single-agent search capabilities trained using synthetic task graphs and RL.

entry.title: OpenAI Details Internal AI Research Acceleration via Autonomous Coding Agents
entry.summary: OpenAI shared early data on how recursive self-improvement and internal coding agents are driving higher experiment velocity in model development.

entry.title: September MCP Security Briefing Highlights Deadbugz Campaign and Server CVEs
entry.summary: A new supply chain campaign and three vulnerabilities in Model Context Protocol servers highlight growing risks in agent tool integration.

entry.title: vLLM Adds Platform Plugin for Tenstorrent Hardware Acceleration
entry.summary: An out-of-tree plugin integrates TTNN kernel implementations into vLLM, broadening open-source LLM serving options beyond mainstream GPUs.

entry.title: Execution-State Unlearning Purges Sensitive Memory from Stateful LLM Agents
entry.summary: It introduces a method to remove private context from working memory, KV caches, and pending tool plans without re-initializing the agent.

entry.title: CONTINUITY Framework Uses Security Contracts to Protect Composable LLM Agents
entry.summary: Assume-guarantee contracts and signed security context prevent context discontinuity attacks across multi-step agent instruction paths.

entry.title: RISE Enables Recursive Self-Improvement via Trajectory-Extrapolated Policy Distillation
entry.summary: Extrapolating policy parameter updates along an RLVR trajectory generates dense, token-level distillation targets without requiring external teacher models.

entry.title: On-Policy Distillation Matches 17K-Example Baseline Using Eight Hard Examples
entry.summary: Selecting training samples that trigger longer chain-of-thought paths drastically reduces the dataset size required for efficient policy distillation.

entry.title: Bayesian Framework Cuts Foundation Model Scaling Law Compute Costs by 10-100x
entry.summary: It replaces expensive full-grid pre-training sweeps with Bayesian optimization to construct accurate scaling laws at a fraction of the compute.

entry.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra for Developers
entry.summary: OpenAI's new model family features enhanced prompt adherence and specialized 3D asset generation capabilities.

entry.title: NVIDIA Acquires Hugging Face for $12.93 Billion
entry.summary: Consolidates the dominant AI hardware vendor with the open-source community's primary model repository.

entry.title: Serving Stack Mismatches Silently Drop Valid Agent Tool Calls
entry.summary: Uncovers an infrastructure flaw where parser and chat template discrepancies cause severe agent performance drops.

entry.title: Black-Box Attack Recovers Forgotten Prompts from Unlearned Models
entry.summary: Demonstrates that target unlearning safety techniques fail to reliably erase prompt data under limited query budgets.

entry.title: Early-Exited Reasoning Models Spill Chain-of-Thought into Final Answers
entry.summary: Shows that injecting end-of-think tokens fails to halt reasoning, causing models to output CoT in answer fields.

entry.title: Single-Layer Attention Requires Exactly k Heads for k-Bit Parity
entry.summary: Establishes a strict theoretical limit on single-layer attention capacity regardless of embedding dimension or precision.

entry.title: Semantic Watermarks Allow Auditing of Unauthorized Third-Party RAG Use
entry.summary: Provides a method for document owners to verify if their proprietary text is being served by external RAG systems.

entry.title: Tabular Foundation Model Pretrained Exclusively on Synthetic Causal Data
entry.summary: Demonstrates strong zero-shot tabular classification and regression without training on real-world datasets.
